name: zero-fill gap
measurable_signature: exact zeros (η = 1) in ≥ 2 cities at once, often after a hold or straight-line fill; returns at once

name: simultaneous fill
measurable_signature: ≥ 2 zones frozen (identical values) or straight-line interpolated over the same span

name: single-zone fill
measurable_signature: one zone frozen or straight-line interpolated; neighbours move normally

name: clock error
measurable_signature: daily profile shifted by δ* ≈ ±60 min after a clock-change date; duplicated or missing stamps

name: regional outage
measurable_signature: noise floor (η < 0.9) in ≥ 2 cities, ramp restoration with cold-load overshoot π ≥ 1.15

name: city outage
measurable_signature: all zones of one city at the noise floor, the other cities normal

name: unplanned feeder outage
measurable_signature: one zone at the noise floor at any hour, possibly > 24 h, ramp restoration

name: planned work
measurable_signature: one zone at the noise floor, starting 06:00–11:59, short (< 6 h)

name: load transfer
measurable_signature: one zone steps down while another steps up by the same amount (conservation κ ≈ 0)
